item.title: UFC Vegas 3 weigh in results
item.description: UFC Vegas 3 is all set to go as just the sole fighter missed weight on Friday morning. In the main event of the evening, a heavyweight showdown between top contenders Curtis Blaydes and Alexander Volkov. Blaydes weighed in at 261lbs while his Russian counterpart tipped the scales at 247. In the co-main event is a pivotal featherweight match up as Josh Emmett will square off against Shane Burgos. item.title: UFC Fight Night: Blaydes v. Volkov Results
item.description: Summer started officially this evening in the Northern Hemisphere, and like the setting sun, the wrestler wrestled the striker. Curtis Blaydes landed his personal, and broke the UFC heavyweight record in single-fight takedowns with 14. Almost an inevitability, Alexander Volkov, a brown-belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, had little answer to the rag-dolling approach of the Colorado fighter. item.title: UFC Vegas 4 Weigh-In Results
item.description: The UFC’s stint at the Apex is coming to a end as all 10 fights are set to go on Saturday night. In the main event, a lightweight showdown between Dustin Poirier and Dan Hooker as both men hit their marks. Dustin weighed in at 156 while Hooker tipped the scales at 155.5. Mike Perry and Mickey Gall will square off in the co-main event as the former looks to get back on track after two straight losses. Gall weighed in at 170 while ‘Platinum’ hit the limit at 171lbs. item.description: While not oceanside in the sand like we were promised, the UFC octagon found its way, somehow, against the odds and recommendation of many, to Fight Island for the first of four scheduled events.
